canonical_decision: Design B (Isolated Thread Files) must be used. Store each thread in its own thread_<id>.json file.
rationale: Prevents silent transcript data loss caused by RAGService's global 200-message cap per container.

canonical_decision: Evidence Threads must be kept strictly local-only in Phase 1.
rationale: WorkspaceSyncService copies everything under baseDir() except LocalCache/ and FTS5/. Placing threads under LocalCache guarantees they do not sync.
prohibited_path: AppSupportPaths.baseDir() or any root path outside local cache

canonical_decision: Implement coordinatedWriteLocalOnlyData(_:to:) in EvidenceThreadStore.swift to write atomically.
rationale: WorkspaceSyncService's coordinatedWriteData posts .localWorkspaceDidChange notifications, triggering continuous sync sweeps during chat streaming. Bypassing it avoids sync overhead.

canonical_decision: Enforce a cap of 3 active threads per library for Free tier users, with unlimited threads for Pro and Lifetime tiers.
rationale: Encourages premium monetization without requiring changes to StoreKit billing validation logic.

canonical_decision: Do not register any App Shortcuts or App Intents for Evidence Threads in Phase 1.
rationale: OpenIntelligence registers 9 shortcuts, leaving only 1 slot before violating Apple's 10 shortcut limit. Thread features must run strictly in-app.
allowed_target_path: In-app UI execution inside ChatScreen.swift only

canonical_decision: Reject claims like '100% on-device processing' and 'never leaves device' in favor of 'local-first' and 'transparent routing'.
rationale: Queries exceeding 4,096 tokens or triggering Deep Think escalate securely to Apple's Private Cloud Compute (PCC) enclaves.
allowed_target_path: Docs/PRIVACY.md; README.md; App Store copy updates

canonical_decision: Copy-forward legacy chat history files to thread_defaultThread.json during first relaunch.
rationale: Maintains user continuity without altering the legacy chat history file schema or performing destructive deletions.
prohibited_path: Deleting or formatting raw chat history JSONs before copying
